subject: POC extension and one-off credits request — Atlas Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Chris Thomas <chris.thomas@atlashealth.ai>, Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC extension and one-off credits request — Atlas Health

Hi all,

Quick context: Atlas Health is mid-POC for our clinical summarization flow. Their technical team is happy with accuracy but procurement is stuck on their standard purchase order cadence — they need an extra month to get the formal PO through legal and vendor onboarding. The POC is due to expire on Sep 30 and that timeline would cut the evaluation short.

This thread is to request a one-time exception: a 60-day bridge extension to the POC period plus a one-off $25k platform credit to cover token usage while procurement finishes. Rationale: Atlas is likely to convert to a paid Dedicated plan (sales estimate ~$150k ARR first year) and they are a good reference in healthcare. Losing momentum here will likely kill the deal.

What I have attached: one-page POC summary and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) with the procurement milestones.

Requested approvals / asks:
- Exec approval for the 60-day POC extension (no change to SLOs, same data handling).
- One-time $25,000 usage credit applied to the account in the sandbox org.
- Allow invoice-on-file / provisional invoicing option so procurement can start payment paperwork while PO is routed.

Next steps if approved: I will send an amended POC addendum and a DocuSign link for the temporary terms; Marissa (CS) will schedule a check-in for 2 weeks out.

Attachments: [Attachment: Atlas_POC_Summary.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC extension and one-off credits request — Atlas Health

Soojin — thanks for the summary. A few quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) Confirm that Atlas will not have access to any production model weights or that there are no additional IP concessions in the addendum.
2) Can you quantify the current spend run rate for the POC (daily tokens / estimated to Sep 30)? I want to ensure $25k is aligned with actual usage.
3) Procurement asking to set up "invoice on file" is okay with Finance but we prefer a provisional invoice (no change to credit terms) rather than stitching in an ad-hoc payment path.

If answers look good, I can approve a one-time extension + the credit on the condition legal signs the short addendum and finance gets the provisional invoice to record.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake | Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Chris Thomas <chris.thomas@atlashealth.ai>, Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC extension and one-off credits request — Atlas Health

Jordan — answers below and attaching the MAP.

1) IP / security: no changes. Atlas will use a sandbox instance with customer-managed data; no model weights or source code will be shared. All access is covered by our standard SaaS security addendum.

2) Spend run-rate: roughly 18M tokens so far across 3 weeks; current projection to Sep 30 is ~$18k. If we extend 60 days at the current momentum I estimate ~ $22k–28k additional spend (high variance as they ramp tests). $25k is the mid-point and a conservative one-off.

3) Procurement: they prefer "invoice on file" to start cashflow paperwork. Finance is amenable to a provisional invoice that notes "pending PO" — we will not accept funds without a completed PO, but this will allow their AP team to record the liability.

Attached: MAP_Atlas_Health.xlsx with milestones and expected signoffs. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8421

Proposed guardrails for the exception (so legal/finance are comfortable):
- Extension limited to 60 calendar days from Sep 30, 2025.
- $25,000 one-time credit applied only to the sandbox org and not refundable.
- Legal must sign a 1-page POC addendum (I will draft).
- Credit will be revoked if Atlas violates any security terms.

If that works I will prepare the addendum and send the DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow. Marissa, can you be ready for the 2-week check-in and coordinate CS tasks?

Thanks — Soojin

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_Atlas_Health.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Chris Thomas <chris.thomas@atlashealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC extension and one-off credits request — Atlas Health

Approved with the guardrails Soojin listed. Summary of decision for the record:

- Approve 60-day POC extension (new end date: Nov 29, 2025).
- Approve $25,000 one-time usage credit against the sandbox org for Atlas Health.
- Finance to issue a provisional invoice referencing "pending PO" (no funds to be accepted without PO).
- Legal to sign the 1-page POC addendum drafted by Soojin — copy legal@redwood.com on the DocuSign.

Soojin — please:
- Send the addendum via DocuSign to Chris and Procurement and include the provision that the credit expires if terms are breached. (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123)
- Add a short note in HubSpot (Deal: DEAL-8421) describing the exception and set a follow-up task for CS.

Marissa — please prepare the 2-week check-in and own the post-extension handoff.

This approval is a one-off exception tied to the Atlas conversation and does not create a precedent. If Finance or Legal raise further concerns please escalate to me directly.

-Jordan

[Attachment reference: amend_msa_docusign_link.txt]
